definitions.clock: Periods 1/2 including added time, excludes extra time and shootouts
definitions.strength: Pre-draw World Cup pot gap; exclude hosts and 2022 unresolved playoff slots; no mapping to game ability
definitions.passSharePct: Event pass-count share, NOT official time-possession percentage

definitions.onTarget: Shot outcomes Goal, Saved, Saved to Post; provider definition
definitions.formation: Starting XI provider formation only; does not identify low blocks or tactical changes
definitions.causality: Observational contextual comparison, not the causal effect of low-block tactics
